text: The UI Designer is tasked with designing a menu for all functions and grouping them into display and basic functions.
There are usability issues with remote controls: poor look-and-feel, hard to learn, and remotes often get lost in rooms.

Decisions establish no teletext (except for TV) and that teletext and the newsflash feature will not be used in the future; classic remote functions will be retained with improved usability and physical design.

The product must include corporate identity with the logo present and colours consistent; the UI will integrate channel-changing functionality and compile a list of functions for the LCD screen menu, with two groups for simple and advanced users.
